summary: No hot-path regression. Part A adds a host-coordinator round-trip only on a scheduled worker-local MISS (hits, birthright, and denylist short-circuits are unchanged); it is the same host call the DeepAgents/interactive lanes already make, and it replaces a wasted denied run with a real authorization. Part B is a net reduction: the terminal notifier now returns early on a setup pause instead of formatting + sending a duplicate card, and the setup-story builder is shorter.
residual_risks: The denylist short-circuit and host consult both run per denied tool call; bounded and only on the miss path.
